newsitem.title: USA: At least 20,000 without power in New England.
newsitem.headline: At least 20,000 without power in New England.

text.p: Northeast Utilities reported at least 20,000 customers in Connecticut and western Massachusetts were without power Wednesday as a line of powerful thunderstorms swept across New England.
"We have about 20,000 customers, most of them in Connecticut and western Massachusetts, without power," Northeast Utilities spokeswoman Susan Milerick said.
Torrential rains and hail pounded parts of Maine and New Hampshire, as well as Massachusetts and Connecticut, downing powerlines.
The National Weather Service reported radar images of a tornado, but apparently it never touched down, state emergency officials said.
Flash flood warnings remained in effect for much of the area and the region was under a thunderstorm watch.
